notes:
Throughout: running heads ('NN REPORT ON THE MIGRATION OF BIRDS.' and 'COAST NAME. NN', often garbled, e.g. 'WEST OOAST OF SCOTLAND. 79', 'EAST COAST OF SCOTLAND. 18' for 13), bare page numbers, signature letters ('B', 'D', '2B') and footnotes ('* ...' blocks) fall in the middle of entries. A cutter should drop them and join the entry back up. Hyphens at line ends ('Pent-' / 'land') split words. 'L.H.'/'L.V.' come out as 'u.H.', 'u.u.', 'u.n.', 't.v.', 'L.#.', 'u.a.', 't.a.' and the like.

Order of the report: Ocean Notes (ships, not stations); East Coast of Scotland (stations, then species by family); East Coast of England (species by Latin name; Stevns table; General Remarks; Dudgeon postscript); West Coast of Scotland (station notes, species by family, then General Remarks covering both Scottish coasts, which the East Coast station list points to at 1511); West Coast of England and Wales (I remarks, II station reports, III diary by date (autumn only), IV species: III and IV repeat many of the same records); Irish Coast (keepers' general remarks by station, then species headings with station entries); Appendix.

Station lists are at 301-641 (the map key with map numbers), 1454-1516, 2991-3104, 4850-5064, 6420-6482 and 8049-8110. In the East of England and West of Scotland lists the OCR has pulled the columns apart (names, feet, keepers in separate runs). The Athenian second-voyage table (1006-1271) is printed sideways and its OCR is reversed gibberish. It can only be recovered from the page image.
